title: Black Feminist Musings on Algorithmic Oppression
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not conduct a benchmark. It theoretically discusses how algorithmic systems perpetuate systemic oppression, specifically naming Islamophobia and anti-Semitism as forms of this oppression. It cites the example of Muslim people being systematically targeted by government surveillance technologies.
findings: The paper posits that algorithmic systems reinforce and amplify existing societal power structures, which includes religious oppression. It identifies 'Christian' as part of the dominant, benefiting group within the 'white supremacist capitalist (cishetero)patriarchy' and describes the targeting of 'Muslim folks' by government surveillance as a form of algorithmic violence. The central argument is that the struggle against algorithmic oppression is inseparable from the struggle against all forms of systemic oppression, including Islamophobia and anti-Semitism.
